name: Ventura Music Hall - VMH
bio: Ventura Music Hall is a concert venue on East Thompson Boulevard in midtown Ventura. Since opening in 2022 it has hosted touring and local acts in rock, reggae, country, metal and more, along with comedy and family shows. Most shows are all ages.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from venturamusichall.com, @venturamusichall and Visit Ventura.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
